title: Sadly surprised.
text:
Sadly surprised.. My first time buying this famous American candle and I was simply shocked how shoddily it was put together! Looks like the candle melted somewhere along the way and a 3rd of it traveled all the way to the top. Had to dig around with a knife to chisel the top part to even find the wick! The candle has a good scent (not sure if that's really eucalyptus) and once I coaxed out the wick, it worked. Not sure if it's the product manufacturer or the person/company that's shipping these! Or maybe it's just Amazon that doesn't pay attention who they allow here to sell stuff.

For the price, I think I got jipped! At $28 a jar, almost twice as much as similar size candles form other manufacturer, this is totally outrageous!
